# Anne Shirley & Josephine Barry

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) — expressed pride in her achievements at Commencement · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P16](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0016), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P25](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0025)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tearfully explains to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) accused her of making [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to check the pantry and realize [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly served currant wine instead of raspberry cordial. After [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) fails to persuade Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) personally begs Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for forgiveness, but she is cold and refuses to let [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) play with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) again. A distraught [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) quietly softens with sympathy as she checks on the sleeping child later that night.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P46](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P57](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0057), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P64](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0064)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), with Matthew's help, to let her go to a [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night at Diana's house. After enjoying the concert and driving with Diana's cousins, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed only to leap on top of Diana's sleeping [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who becomes furious.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P9](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P27](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P58](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0058)_

> After discussing her predicament with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping into her bed. Anne's honest confession and earnest defense of [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) win over Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), who laughs, agrees to forgive [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and decides to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after all.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P66](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0066), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P83](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0083), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P90](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0090)_

> At Diana's party, [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dares [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts the dare, loses her balance, and falls, breaking her ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) carries her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and the doctor puts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on several weeks of bed rest.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. > [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) invites [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a trip to town with her [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) to attend the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). The girls stay at Aunt Josephine's mansion, enjoying the sights, horse races, and a night concert before happily returning home.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) bid [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) goodbye after enjoying their stay, with [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) reflecting fondly on Anne's presence. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive home to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a warm welcome and hot supper from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) adjusts to life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), forming a close group of ambitious friends and continuing her friendly academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She frequently visits [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) and stays focused on her studies. As examinations approach in the spring, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her philosophical mindset with her classmates while they anxiously prepare for tests and discuss commencement attire.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P11](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0011)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays, which are dampened by severe winter weather, awkward visits from [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and worries about her college finances. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) engages [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in amusing chatter until Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) delivers the mail. Among the letters, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that Miss Josephine Barry has died and left her a thousand dollars in her will.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl
